title: Director, Operations - QDC
description:
About Us:

QISG leverages Quanta’s comprehensive resources to deliver collaborative solutions for our partners' energy infrastructure needs. We use in\-house talent, expertise and resources to plan, design, engineer, manage, conduct maintenance on and construct projects.  

Our turnkey service capabilities provide our customers with efficiency, consistency, attention to detail and safe execution. The QISG team brings together Engineering, Safety, Quality, Material Procurement, QA/QC, Right\-of\-Way Acquisition, Scheduling, Environmental Planning, Permitting, Title and Land Management expertise that ensure outstanding results for our clients.
About this Role:

Quanta Infrastructure Solutions Group, LLC (QISG), a Quanta Services, Inc. company (NYSE: PWR) is looking for a Director, Operations leads full lifecycle delivery of large\-scale advanced technology construction programs across an assigned portfolio. Reporting to the Vice President, Operations, this role owns leadership and development of assigned teams, client relationships, contract administration, and financial performance across multiple concurrent projects. The Director, Operations serves as the primary operational authority between executive leadership and the project management office (PMO), and is accountable for project delivery, safety, quality, schedule, and cost outcomes across the assigned projects.
What You'll Do:  

Duties \& Responsibilites**Program \& PMO Leadership*** Leads assigned PMO spanning Project Executives, Project Managers, Assistant Project Managers, Preconstruction, Cost, Scheduling, and Contracts
* Owns assigned PMO oversight: project delivery, escalation protocols, and reporting standards across Safety, Quality, Execution, and Cost
* Develops and maintains program\-level portfolio tracking covering schedule, cost, risk, and resource utilization for multi\-site construction programs
* Drives project execution strategy including contract structures, change management, cost\-of\-work

description:
**Energy Solutions Development Engineer (Distributed Generation)**

**About OnSite Partners**


OnSite Partners’ mission is to empower each customer in achieving success through the design and delivery of collaborative, creative and comprehensive energy solutions.

  

Overview:


We are seeking a thoughtful and talented engineer to support the design of distribution generation projects.


Candidate will utilize customer information, utility tariff and technical system knowledge to assess, select, design, and support the feasibility of behind the meter customer solutions. Candidate will also support the cost estimation efforts for projects.

* Provide technical support for projects in the development phase, including feasibility assessment, and conceptual design of behind the meter energy solutions and evaluation of trade\-offs of different design options. Ensure project designs meet customer requirements, deliver value\-added outcomes, effectively managing risks, and maximizing project returns.

* Prepare and coordinate technical documentation to support a seamless transition from development to project execution, with clear communication of all requirements and deliverables.
  

Requirements

* 3 – 5 years’ experience in engineering or related roles
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanic

title: Senior Project Manager - Austin, TX
description:
Bilfinger is a leading international industrial services provider, driving efficiency and sustainability for the process industry. With about 31,000 employees and over €5\.4 billion in revenue in 2025, we offer solutions in consulting, engineering, manufacturing, maintenance, turnarounds, and digital applications across key sectors like energy, chemicals, pharma, and oil \& gas.

description:

=====================================


LC\-ERP\-01 \| Lake City Microgrid and CHP \| Awarded project recruiting

-----------------------------


Energy Resilience Partners, LLC (ERP) is a tribally led SBA 8(a) federal contractor advancing energy resilience and mission assurance. The project integrates a 15 MW dual\-fuel turbine CHP system, HRSGs and steam interfaces, natural\-gas and backup propane systems, 12\.47 kV distribution and substations, SEL\-based protection, microgrid controls, cybersecurity, operator training, and full commissioning at an operating industrial facility.
